title: Recover the refrigerant before opening the A/C system
when: before the compressor, condenser or lines are disturbed

title: Keep a stored lithium battery above its BMS cutoff
when: monthly while the Ionic S9 waits unfitted

title: Jack the car and set it on safety stands
when: before any work under the car
tools: floor jack, safety stands, wheel chocks

title: Tow the car
when: whenever the car is moved by a tow truck or a rope
tools: tow truck with a wheel lift, or wheel dollies

title: Change the engine oil and filter
when: oil every 7,500 mi / 7.5 months, filter every 15,000 mi / 15 months (interval oil)

title: Check the drive belts
Check the spark plugs
when: every 15,000 mi / 15 months; replace at 30,000 mi / 30 months (interval plugs)

title: Check the cooling system for leaks
Replace the engine coolant
Check the brake pedal, parking brake and power brake unit
Check the steering gear oil level
tools: a length of wire as a dipstick

title: Clean and repack the front wheel bearings
tools: solvent, lithium grease NLGI No. 2, new oil seals

title: Check or replace the rear axle oil
when: level at 7,500 mi, replace every 30,000 mi / 30 months (interval diff)

title: Check the seat belts, buckles, retractors and anchors
Scheduled chassis inspection: brakes, steering, suspension, exhaust shields, fasteners
Check and set the idle speed (12A, factory carburettor)
when: at the scheduled idle speed check

title: Check and adjust the throttle sensor (12A, factory carburettor)
when: at pre-delivery and when deceleration control is in doubt

title: Clean the choke system (factory carburettor)
tools: carburettor spray cleaner, compressed air, spray lubricant

title: Check the oil level warning system (1985 manual)
Check the coolant level warning system (1985 manual)
Check the sub-zero starting assist system (12A, factory carburettor)
Check the automatic transmission fluid level (1985 manual, L4N71B)
when: at 7,500 mi, then every 30,000 mi / 30 months (interval atf)
